text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #c3c2b7

g.text: % after 5.30 ms - type III, 4 kHz: dip 6.4 %, back inside 1 % after 0.20 ms. Twenty times the bandwidth

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #c3c2b7

g.text: buys a shallower dip and a recovery several times faster, which is what the extra two poles and two

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #c3c2b7

g.text: zeros of the type III are actually for.
